pages.title: ORSA Thermal Survey Optic
pages.text: $(bold)Recovered designation:$() Surveyor Lens.$(br2)The Returned Architect carried optics tuned to infrastructure instead of faces.

ORSA engineers have repurposed one into a field scanner for detecting $(bold)active thermal anchors$() underground.$(br2)$(italic)Translation: the monster's eye now helps you find the one heater you forgot to refuel.$()

pages.title: Field Use
pages.text: $(bold)Acquisition:$() Returned Architects occasionally drop one.$(br2)$(bold)Passive:$() hold it in either hand for a thermal wash over your visor. Nearby heat infrastructure is marked.

$(bold)Ping:$() right-click to pulse for $(l:advanced/geothermal_core)Geothermal Cores$(/l), lit Thermal Heaters, surfaced $(l:heating/geothermal_vents)vents$(/l), $(l:orsa_rd/acheron_forge)Acheron Forges$(/l) and Transponders.
$(italic)The base model ignores lava, candles and Kevin from Logistics.$()

pages.title: Low-Band Carriers
pages.text: Late in the event, the optic may catch a carrier that is $(bold)not thermal$(). Right-click again while moving through the search area.$(br2)Distant interference has no usable bearing. A stronger pulse resolves into a directional bias, then broken language.

Close-range lock stores the signature as a Hearth contact.$(br2)The calibrated lens reaches much farther and can isolate weaker secondary carriers.$(br2)$(italic)No map point is generated. ORSA cannot map something that appears to be listening back.$()

pages.title: Calibrated Array
pages.text: Lens, $(l:orsa_rd/soul_harvesting)Architect Soul$(/l), 4 Refined Acheronite and a diamond. Longer range, more markers, and it filters out torch and lava clutter.

pages.title: ORSA Thermal Visor
pages.text: Two calibrated lenses, insulated cloth and an iron housing. Worn on the head:$(li)Hands-free thermal overlay$(li)+20°C cold resistance$(li)A brief air buffer in vacuum
With an EVA body rig and oxygen, the visor stretches tank life noticeably.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA calls the rebreather "field sufficient." Legal made them remove "probably."$()
